reviews.title: Terrible communication
reviews.text:
No return on investment.  This app is terrible, no response to my add. My husband accidentally deleted our add when trying to add pictures and when I reached out to Cycle Trader 3x I got no response. Do yourself a favor and advertise local
**CT responded with a generic “let us know your device model so we can look into this”- yeah, so the $89.99 I paid for the add is gone at this point. Again, very disappointed

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text: Who programs this app? Models im looking for arent even an option on the drop down boxes.lol

reviews.title: Seller Beware…It just doesn’t get the traction that it used to…
reviews.text: I have listed a couple bikes in the past 6 and 9 years ago) and had great results.  I believe all the competition has crushed cycle trader.  I am taking down my listing.  They also have this ridiculous feature where u can text customer service and then never hear back from anyone.  I regret paying for this.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: I get constant, unwanted emails. I get an error message when I try to unsubscribe. I get an error message when I try to delete my account. Save yourself the aggravation.

reviews.title: Very Buggy
reviews.text: The search filters are very limited.  For example unless ABS appears in the actual name of the bike, you’re unable to search for bikes with ABS.  Another annoyance is the payment calculator which suddenly will only calculate payments for up to 20 months…if you want to see payment for a 36 month loan or longer, you are shid out of luck.

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text:
Probably the worst app I’ve seen, but your only option on apple.   I always run into the issue that it can’t find anything in my state.    

I have better luck on Facebook marketplace

reviews.title: Absolutely Terrible
reviews.text: Could not have found a worse place to try and sell my motorcycle. Did all the bells and whistles including getting a vehicle history report. Unfortunately for me the vehicle history report was a joke and completely wrong. Stated my bike was stolen then recovered which never happened in a state the bike had never been in. Would they correct it? Of course not. So as you can guess people were not lining up to buy my low mileage motorcycle like new motorcycle. It was a complete waste of money and time and effort

reviews.title: The worst app I’ve ever used
reviews.text: This app is the reason the world is bad.

reviews.title: Zip code invalid!?!?!?!
reviews.text: Says my zip code is not valid, unable to use app. 100% frustration.

reviews.title: Can’t Log In and Listings Lack Prices
reviews.text: What’s the point of using CycleTrader if you can’t even log in or create a new account? I emailed customer service about the issue and never received a response. Many of the motorcycles listed also don’t show a price, which makes it difficult to compare bikes or make a buying decision. Between the account problems, lack of support, and missing basic listing information, this app is extremely frustrating to use.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: The app has had issues for years but since the latest update if you change how they are sorted, you have to redo the entire saved search. Maybe take lessons from RV and Auto Trader.

reviews.title: Awful Updates Lately
reviews.text:
Stop making things in the app that nobody asked for. 
There are too many to track and no desire to write them all. 
I’ll give you the most annoying one. 
Location and radius should be part of the regular filter because you dynamically populate the make and model list based on that. 
Just have a normal person test it for you. 
BTW, your current app rating is from before and does not reflect the current app rework.

reviews.title: Zip Code problem still not fixed????
reviews.text: Every time I try to enter a new zip code it would say zipcode invalid.

reviews.title: Not accurate
reviews.text: It’s like pandora, I picks specific bike it shows all that’s thousands of miles away from me. I made area specific

reviews.title: New app is terrible
reviews.text: The old app was great and easy to use. The new app is slow, buggy, and cumbersome. IMHO

reviews.title: Bad app to use
reviews.text: I’m going to be honest. This app and website of CycleTrader is a scam. You’re not going to be able to sell or buy a motorcycle on this. They are just trying to take your money. Don’t waste your time. Go to a dealer.

reviews.title: Always freezes
reviews.text: Tried the app for three days and every time I click on a new bike I have to re-sign in. And it’s constantly freezing. Love the content and it could be great, but cannot deal with that.

reviews.title: Doesn't work, support only available bankers hours
reviews.text: App doesn't work consistently, lack or broken ability to respond to interested buyers. Save the $$$ you"re better off buying a "for sale" sign and parking at curb

reviews.title: Vibe coded slop
reviews.text: Couldn’t be more unintuitive and unusable. What should be a simple task becomes a wander through a labyrinth of confusing, non consistent menus. it’s easy to tell that the coders are not the demographic of users.

reviews.title: Login Problems and Filtering
reviews.text: Removed a filtering mechanic that allows sorting by year, price, distance.

reviews.title: Just stop it
reviews.text: Have used this app for literal years, but every single time it’s updated there’s an issue. I’m fed up with these bug riddled updates! Here’s an idea, leave it the F alone!!! As usual I’ll delete it and wait for the fix, so annoying

reviews.title: Crashes
reviews.text: I have dled this app several times always forgetting why I delete it. It crashes every time I try and save a motorcycle. The website is so much easier. Everything is updated and it still crashes. So I get an email from the developer to give them my device with no way to contact them!!! That’s how’s their lack of undertaking of the reality of the real world. CODERS!!

reviews.title: Terrible User Interface
reviews.text: Trying to use this app is a waste of time. The search engine never shows results for what I search.

reviews.title: Bots and Scammers
reviews.text: In my experience 9/10 of the responses I have gotten have been bots, spam and scammers.

reviews.title: Latest update sucks
reviews.text: The search filters are absolutely useless please please I beg you, bring back the previous version search interface

reviews.title: Barely Any Bikes
reviews.text: This app used to be great for finding bikes. Seems like barely anyone lists on here anymore

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text: Ever since they redesigned the app, it’s horrible. Crashes , glitchy UI.

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text: They put the wrong city in my listing. Cannot get ahold of customer service through text or phone calls. Do not list with these people

reviews.title: No engine size filter
reviews.text: The app fails to filter by engine size, even when that data is in the listing. Utter fail.

reviews.title: Latest version is broke
reviews.text: Latest version doesn’t format filter page correctly. When selecting things like Model the “more choices” selection is covered by the “APPLY” menu. I can move it up to debuting moves back down when I release it.

reviews.title: Do you even test this
reviews.text: The WHOLE POINT of the app is to scroll through bikes for sale. Now the scrolling on iPad is a narrow column WTF. And it’s slow and clunky. It was ok the way you had it before. Search and look through a list of results IT AINT THAT COMPLICATED.

reviews.title: Ads in listings
reviews.text: Why in the world am I paying $25 to list my vehicle and there are ads mixed in with my photos?  If it were a free ad, sure - but if I'm paying to list on a site, there shouldn't be ANY ads INSIDE MY LISTING.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: Tried the Cycle Trader app on both my iPhone and my iPad. First, Google sign-in doesn’t work. It just keeps returning to the login screen. Second, selecting more than one make prevents you from expanding the selection to select multiple models. What’s the point of that feature if you can’t use it? Third, clicking on the same listing after returning to search results generates a message “This bike has been sold.” Viewing Cycle Trader through the browser is less frustrating.

reviews.title: Search function is terrible
reviews.text: Guess you need ios17 to run this app, cause your search function sucks. I can select whatever I am looking for, but I still get the same 4 bikes that aren’t even what I’m looking for.

reviews.title: App Sucks with IPad
reviews.text: This app used to work and be great on my IPad Pro but somebody that had to justify having a job made changes and now the app is ABSOLUTE TRASH!!! Unable to select specific trims on models like  (Road Glide CVO ST). So it displays every Road Glide possible but also shows models of completely different bikes in your search results. Freezes up to point where app has to be closed out then restarted. Just terrible!!

reviews.title: App doesn’t work
reviews.text: The app literally won’t work. It’s like the software isn’t finished.

reviews.title: Garbage
reviews.text: Download. Search. Crash. Complete garbage. Nothing has changed over the years.
